messages:
maria: PTAL — I pushed fixes addressing the routing change you flagged and rebased on main. Left one behavioral question about default_timeout vs request_timeout.
shubham: Reviewing now, thanks. what's the expected behavior if both are present? fallback order?
alex: quick thing: we need a changelog line for this, otherwise looks fine at a glance.
maria: good catch @alex — added a brief changelog entry in CHANGELOG.md and bumped helm chart `app.version`.
shubham: hmm small nit in the comment in src/router/timeout.go, can you make it explicit that default_timeout is global and request_timeout overrides it?
maria: yep, done. also added a unit test for the override case:
```
// Ensure request timeout overrides default
assert.Equal(t, 1500, computeTimeout(cfgDefault, reqTimeout))
```
shubham: thanks — that test covers it. left one comment about variable naming, otherwise LGTM.
ci-bot: build passed — all checks green :white_check_mark: 
maria: resolved the naming nit and squashed. re-requesting review @shubham @alex :ptal:
alex: lgtm, thanks. feel free to merge when CI stays green for a few mins.
shubham: lgtm as well, merging after a quick canary.
maria: thanks all :tada:
